messages:
alex: quick question — need alignment on error codes for auth header / project scoping edge cases. currently different services return 400/401/403 in slightly inconsistent ways, and SDK mapping gets confusing. example cases below.

maya: can you paste the cases?

alex: sure. cases: 
1) no auth header at all (proxy stripped headers)
2) auth header present but API key is expired/rotated
3) valid API key but missing X-Project-ID and org fallback not allowed
4) API key is valid but not authorized for the requested project (org mismatch)
5) malformed X-Project-ID (bad format)
6) both Authorization and X-Api-Key present (which wins)

sasha: my instinct: 1->401, 2->401 (expired/invalid), 3->401 or 400? 4->403, 5->400, 6->priority to Authorization header (Bearer) + log a telemetry warning.

jordan: +1 on 4->403. For 3, I'd prefer 401 if auth exists but no project scoping applied because SDKs expect "unauthenticated for project" mapping. But if the header is syntactically fine and we treat project absence as invalid request, 400 also makes sense. Need to pick one for consistent SDK behavior.

maya: decision tradeoff: 401 signals auth failure (token missing/invalid) vs 400 signals bad request. For missing X-Project-ID we have two semantics: (a) allow implicit org fallback -> treat as authenticated (200) or (b) require explicit project -> treat as bad request. We already have a rollout to require explicit project for new tenants. so probably 400 for missing project when tenant requires it. For backwards compatibility, fall back to 401 only when there is no token.

alex: proposal: 
- case 1 (no auth header): 401 + body {"code":"unauthenticated","message":"missing authentication"} 
- case 2 (expired/invalid key): 401 + {"code":"invalid_credentials","message":"api key expired or revoked"} 
- case 3 (auth present, project header missing, tenant requires explicit project): 400 + {"code":"missing_project","message":"X-Project-ID required for this tenant"} (but 200 if tenant allows implicit fallback)
- case 4 (valid key but not allowed for project/org): 403 + {"code":"forbidden","message":"key not authorized for project"} 
- case 5 (malformed project id): 400 + {"code":"invalid_project","message":"malformed X-Project-ID"} 
- case 6 (both auth headers): precedence: Authorization: Bearer > X-Api-Key header. if both provided and conflict -> 401 + telemetry:auth_conflict

sasha: sounds reasonable. we should ensure SDKs map 401->re-auth prompt, 403->permission denied. also add error fields: "hint" with short remediation and "docs" link.

jordan: also add a header in responses x-auth-reason for easier debugging (internal only) like x-auth-reason: missing-project or invalid-key, but we must strip in prod to avoid leaking info. maybe only expose for internal clients or when ?debug param present.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: auth-service v3.12.0 -> canary at 2026-03-19T02:00Z, rollout window 2h. feature-flag: require-explicit-project = on for canary tenants.

maya: action items: 
- alex: write/update API contract doc + example responses and telemetry keys (for SDK mapping)
- sasha: add tests for all 6 cases in auth-service unit + integration tests
- jordan: add x-auth-reason header gated behind internal flag and document privacy considerations
- infra: coordinate canary flag and ensure proxies don't strip Authorization by default

alex: TL;DR: unify codes -> 401 = unauthenticated (missing/invalid token), 403 = authenticated but unauthorized for resource, 400 = client request problem (missing/malformed project when required). precedence: Bearer auth wins. add telemetry keys: auth_missing, auth_invalid, auth_forbidden, auth_conflict, missing_project, invalid_project.

sasha: I'll send a quick PR with the test matrix and some sample curl snippets.

jordan: sample curl for docs:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123" -H "X-Project-ID: proj_789" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/engines
```

maya: one more edge: how to behave for batch endpoints with mixed-per-request scoping? suggest reject whole batch with 400 and include per-item error details.

alex: agreed. reject-with-details (400) + per-item codes in body.

infra-bot: note: we've observed ~0.4% requests via old proxy missing Authorization header in last 24h, will add telemetry spike alert if >1% during canary.

maya: thanks — feels like enough to move forward. alex please share the contract update here when done and we can link to the SDK mapping PR. :thumbsup:
